name: Default
shortDescription: Open source OpenStreetMap routing engine with an HTTP API for routing, isochrones, matrices and map matching, building its graph from PBF extracts.

alerts.message: Set TILE_URLS to the OpenStreetMap PBF extracts you need before the first deploy. The default is the small Andorra extract. Tiles are only built once: to switch region later, empty the data volume and redeploy. Large regions can take hours and many GB of RAM to build.
